Experiment

Last compiled on 30-09-2026

1 Getting started

To copy the code, click the button in the upper right corner of the code-chunks.

1.1 clean up

rm(list = ls())
gc()


1.2 custom functions

We defined a number custom functions, at Download custom_functions.R.

source("./custom_functions.R")


1.3 necessary packages

  • tidyverse: data wrangling
  • igraph: generate and visualize graphs
  • parallel: parallel computing to speed up simulation
  • foreach: looping in parallel
  • doParallel: parallel backend for foreach
  • ggplot2: data visualization
  • cowplot
  • ggh4x: hacks for ggplot2
  • ggpubr: make visualizations publication-ready
packages = c("tidyverse", "igraph", "ggplot2", "parallel", "doParallel", "foreach", "ggh4x", "ggpubr",
    "plotly", "RColorBrewer", "grid", "gridExtra", "patchwork", "ggplotify", "ggraph", "gganimate", "RColorBrewer",
    "ggtext", "magick", "jsonlite", "lubridate", "ggtext", "cowplot", "ggbeeswarm")

invisible(fpackage.check(packages))
rm(packages)

2 Import data

Import the public data. You may obtain it by downloading: Download data_shared.csv.

df_long_all <- read.csv("./data_shared/data_shared.csv")
# aggregate per session, round, condition
df_plot <- df_long_all %>%
    group_by(source_file, cond, round) %>%
    summarise(pct_choice1 = mean(choice, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# condition labels
df_plot$cond <- factor(df_plot$cond, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Random network", "Heterogeneous network\n(centralized minority)"))

# percentage to proportion
df_plot$pct_choice1 <- df_plot$pct_choice1/100

# create trajectory ID within condition (1–10)
df_plot <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(cond) %>%
    mutate(traj_id = as.numeric(factor(source_file))) %>%
    ungroup()

# raw data of condition 1:
p1 <- ggplot(df_plot[df_plot$cond == unique(df_plot$cond)[1], ], aes(x = round, y = pct_choice1, group = source_file,
    color = source_file)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40") + geom_point(aes(shape = factor(traj_id)), size = 2) + scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 3, 7, 8, 0, 1, 2, 4)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,
    1, by = 0.2)) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_pubclean() + theme(legend.position = "none")

# and condition 2:
p2 <- ggplot(df_plot[df_plot$cond == unique(df_plot$cond)[2], ], aes(x = round, y = pct_choice1, group = source_file,
    color = source_file)) + geom_line(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40") + geom_point(aes(shape = factor(traj_id)), size = 2) + scale_color_viridis_d(option = "C") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 3, 7, 8, 0, 1, 2, 4)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,
    1, by = 0.2)) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_pubclean() + theme(legend.position = "none")

3 make plot of network conditions and model simulations

# library(igraph) library(ggplotify) library(gridExtra) library(grid) library(dplyr) library(purrr)
# library(ggplot2)

net <- jsonlite::fromJSON("./networks/network_test_n50.json")
g1 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net$adj_matrix, mode = "undirected")
V(g1)$role <- ifelse(net$role_vector == 1, "trendsetter", "conformist")

net <- jsonlite::fromJSON("./networks/network_test_n50_random.json")
g2 <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(net$adj_matrix, mode = "undirected")
V(g2)$role <- ifelse(net$role_vector == 1, "trendsetter", "conformist")

# network plots:
p_net1 <- as.grob(function() {
    op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
    par(pty = "s", mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

    fplot_graph(g1, legend = FALSE, layout_algo = layout_with_kk)

    text(-0.38, 1.1, "Heterogeneous network\n(centralized minority)", cex = 0.7, font = 2)

    par(op)
})

p_net2 <- as.grob(function() {
    op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
    par(pty = "s", mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

    fplot_graph(g2, legend = FALSE, layout_algo = layout_with_kk)

    text(-0.38, 1.1, "Random network", cex = 0.7, font = 2)

    par(op)
})

# combine with networks
nets <- grid.arrange(p_net1, p_net2, ncol = 2)

# 1. representative simulation from stochastic model on network conditions (epsilon=.10)
sims <- map_dfr(1:10, function(i) {
  test <- fabm(
    network = g1,
    params = list(s = 15, e = 10, w = 40, z = 50,
                  lambda1 = 4.3, lambda2 = 1.8),
    max_rounds = 30,
    mi_threshold = 0.49,
    epsilon = 0.10,
    choice_rule = "probabilistic",
    #initial_blue_prob=.20,
    stable_window = 50
  )

  test$outcomes %>%
    filter(outcome == "follow_trend") %>%
    mutate(trial = i)
})

sims2 <- map_dfr(1:10, function(i) {
  test <- fabm(
    network = g2,
    params = list(s = 15, e = 10, w = 40, z = 50,
                  lambda1 = 4.3, lambda2 = 1.8),
    max_rounds = 30,
    mi_threshold = 0.49,
    epsilon = 0.10,
    choice_rule = "probabilistic",
    #initial_blue_prob=.20,
    stable_window = 50
  )

  test$outcomes %>%
    filter(outcome == "follow_trend") %>%
    mutate(trial = i)
})

#combine datasets
sims_all <- bind_rows(
  sims  %>% mutate(network = "g1"),
  sims2 %>% mutate(network = "g2")
)

sims_plot_prob10 <- sims_all %>%
  mutate(
    cond = recode(
      network,
      g1 = "Heterogeneous network\n(centralized minority)",
      g2 = "Random network"
    )
  )


p <- ggplot(
  sims_plot_prob10,
  aes(
    x = factor(round),
    y = statistic
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = cond, colour = cond),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    alpha = 0.6,
    outlier.alpha = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = 16
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.10,
    linetype = "longdash",
    color = "darkgrey",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = function(x) x[seq(1, length(x), by = 2)]
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Round",
    y = "Unpopular norm",
    fill = NULL,
    colour = NULL
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Random network" = "#0072B2",
      "Heterogeneous network\n(centralized minority)" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Random network" = "#0072B2",
      "Heterogeneous network\n(centralized minority)" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +

  theme_pubclean() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.7, 0.40),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
   
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
     axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10)
  )
# 2 majorities have a .2 probability of following unpopular norm in round 1 only.
sims <- map_dfr(1:10, function(i) {
  test <- fabm(
    network = g1,
    params = list(s = 15, e = 10, w = 40, z = 50,
                  lambda1 = 4.3, lambda2 = 1.8),
    max_rounds = 30,
    mi_threshold = 0.49,
    epsilon = 0.10,
    choice_rule = "random_blue",
    initial_blue_prob=.2,
    stable_window = 50
  )

  test$outcomes %>%
    filter(outcome == "follow_trend") %>%
    mutate(trial = i)
})

sims2 <- map_dfr(1:10, function(i) {

    initial_blue_prob=.2,
    stable_window = 50
  )

  test$outcomes %>%
    filter(outcome == "follow_trend") %>%
    mutate(trial = i)
})

# 3 smooth, probabilistic version of the step-function where utility differences are converted into choice probabilities via a logistic function (cf Centola et al2005)

sims <- map_dfr(1:10, function(i) {
  test <- fabm(
    network = g1,
    params = list(s = 15, e = 10, w = 40, z = 50,
                  lambda1 = 4.3, lambda2 = 1.8),
    max_rounds = 30,
    mi_threshold = 0.49,
    #epsilon = 0.10,
    choice_rule = "logistic",
    beta=0.25,
    #initial_blue_prob=.2,
    stable_window = 50
  )

  test$outcomes %>%
    filter(outcome == "follow_trend") %>%
    mutate(trial = i)
})

})

# and majority-perceptions

perceptions <- df_long_all %>%
  distinct(participant.code, source_file, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      survey.1.player.majority == 1 ~ "Red",
      survey.1.player.majority == 2 ~ "Blue",
      survey.1.player.majority == 3 ~ "DK",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    role = participant.role
  )

perceptions <- perceptions[perceptions$role == "Red",]

final_adoption <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(source_file, cond) %>%
  filter(round == max(round)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cond = as.numeric(cond)) %>%
  select(
    source_file,
    cond,
    p_blue_follow = pct_choice1
  )

trial_data <- perceptions %>%
  group_by(source_file, cond) %>%
  summarise(
    
    # strict: DK counts as wrong
    p_wrong_strict = mean(response != "Red", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # conditional: among non-DK only (Blue = 1, Red = 0)
    p_wrong_cond = sum(response == "Blue", na.rm = TRUE) /
                   sum(response %in% c("Red", "Blue"), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    n_strict = sum(!is.na(response)),
    n_conditional = sum(response %in% c("Red", "Blue"), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

trial_data <- trial_data %>%
  left_join(
    final_adoption %>% select(source_file, p_blue_follow),
    by = "source_file"
  )

trial_data <- trial_data %>%
  mutate(
    cond = factor(
      cond,
      levels = c(1, 0),
      labels = c("HET", "RAND")
    )
  )

summary_strict <- trial_data %>%
  group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(p_wrong_strict, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_adoption = mean(p_blue_follow, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_cond <- trial_data %>%
  group_by(cond) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(p_wrong_cond, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_adoption = mean(p_blue_follow, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_strict <- ggplot(trial_data, aes(x = cond, y = p_wrong_strict)) +

  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = p_blue_follow),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = summary_strict,
    aes(x = cond, y = mean_error, color = mean_adoption),
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = summary_strict,
    aes(
      x = cond,
      y = mean_error,
      label = round(mean_error, 2)
    ),
    nudge_x = 0.15,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Misperception",
    color = "Unpop. norm (t=25)"
  ) +
  theme_pubclean() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

p_cond <- ggplot(trial_data, aes(x = cond, y = p_wrong_cond)) +

  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = p_blue_follow),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = summary_cond,
    aes(x = cond, y = mean_error, color = mean_adoption),
    size = 3
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = summary_cond,
    aes(
      x = cond,
      y = mean_error,
      label = round(mean_error, 2)
    ),
    nudge_x = 0.15,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Misperception",
    color = "Unpop. norm (t=25)"
  ) +
  theme_pubclean() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

combi <- ggarrange(
  p_strict,
  p_cond,
  ncol = 2,
  common.legend = FALSE,
  legend = "none"
)
#combi
 
combi_with_space <- ggarrange(
  combi,
  NULL,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 0.3)
)

legend <- ggpubr::get_legend(
  p_cond + theme(legend.position = "right")
)

combi_with_legend <- ggdraw(combi_with_space) +
  draw_grob(legend, x = 0.49, y = 0, width = .80, height = 1)
combs <- ggarrange(pe, combi_with_legend, ncol = 1, heights = c(2.2, 1))

combs
